items.title: Harrison Verrett Interview, 1961-08-10
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I don't think he was related to Edmond Hall or Clarence Hall or anything. [INTERVIEWEE] No, he wasn't.

ctx.x: No, I asked him whether he related to Gene Hall, this guy showed you. He said, no, well Gene comes from Mississippi. I don't know. He said no, but he don't know. I looked at his mother. I used to think it was his mother, but it wasn't his mother. He was adopted. See, he was an adopted child. Why? He was an adopted child. But she, not so long ago, she was real low and she asked me if I was getting contact or Rennie Hall, and I did. She died. He came down. She was buried and everything. See, that's not so long ago,…
I don't think he was related to Edmond Hall or Clarence Hall or anything.
No, he wasn't. No, that's what I said. That's why I said he was adopted, so they might have given him that name, you know, Hall, see for a baby.
